items.section: 3.6 Genetic sharing — a code and its machinery
items.text: A count a reconstruction returns and a rung a ladder names are two kinds, and no numeral joins them. A rotational repeat is imposed on a reconstruction before it is reported, so a repeat of thirteen at one structure and a rung of thirteen at a ladder part by their subjects. Four appearances of one numeral within one structure — a chain count, that count doubled, a cap repeat and a trimer count — are one count divided by three and restated, and not four arrivals. An absent numeral at a second structure with a different chain count excludes nothing, since a different count carries different divisors. Whether a numeral of a field parts from the odd composites beside it decides whether a relation is a prime's or is oddness's.

items.section: 3.7 Structural-protein surface — a matrix as a living set: a self
items.text: A particle imaged by atomic force microscopy in liquid at room temperature closes again at a parting an instrument induced, and the closing stands after the instrument has gone. Recovery times part into three: a restoration of force during the backward curve, under 650 ms, while the tip is retracting; no restoration of force with the next topography carrying an intact particle, 650 ms to 2 s, after the tip has left; and the parted topography imaged whole before its closing, over 2 s. Twenty-two events of reversible topographic damage stand at 11 reclining particles, each over 2 s. One reclining particle returns to its first shape within 90 s. Across 617 force-indentation curves at 26 half particles and 28 reclining particles, 179 of 260 curves at half particles recover under 650 ms; at reclining particles the account says 22% where its own 97 of 357 divides to 27%, two sayings parting and both standing. The partings run at the contacts between two neighbouring proteins, in the direction those proteins align, and not at the waist. Under repeated indentation every curve carries a drop and the structure after the cyclic loading stands unaltered. A field's word for it is reversible topographic damage, and a field's condition for the closing is that the bonds self-repair simply by standing in a liquid environment at room temperature. A parting an instrument induces is an observing of that instrument interfering, and a particle's going on without an instrument is not observed here.
